name: routesense-site
description: RouteSense root package to manage frontend and backend concurrently

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "flask,node,frontend" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "python backend/python-flask/app.py" "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "flask,node,frontend" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "python backend/python-flask/app.py" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && pip install -r backend/python-flask/requirements.txt
